comment: Manual overrides from the data-honesty audit — findings the per-paragraph refuters could not reach. B1: a technically-nonsense set; A2/A3: two weak single distractors. Each replacement was re-checked for prefix-plausibility, register, and no future-leak.

fixes.why: B1 — after 'vanilla HTML, CSS, and ___' the truth is JavaScript; the old set [vanilla,little,sometimes] was nonsense in a tech list. These are all plausible list-final web-language tokens.
A2 — a signature line '— ___': 'Written' (as in 'Written by…') reads as a plausible sign-off opener; the old 'The' was thin.
A3 — '…was sound — ___': 'sound' would immediately repeat the just-spoken 'sound'; 'there' is a cleaner plausible continuation.
